task_completion.description: The agent navigates to the axial slice showing the main pulmonary artery at the level of its bifurcation into left and right branches.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The axial view shows the 'inverted Y' or 'T' shape where the main pulmonary artery splits.

task_completion.description: The agent prepares the measurement data in the required JSON format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal shows a JSON structure with keys: diameter_mm, slice_number, and clinical_interpretation.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the results to the specific file path: /home/ga/Documents/SlicerData/Exports/pa_measurement.json.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer window, a 'Save As' dialog, or a terminal command confirms the file was written to the exact specified directory and filename.

integrity.description: The agent used the medical imaging software's GUI tools to measure rather than just guessing.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with measurement tools or markup modules within the software interface.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply type the JSON without performing the measurement steps first.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the measurement being drawn on the scan before the JSON file is created.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual 3D Slicer (or equivalent) environment.
integrity.visual_evidence: The application window title and layout match the expected medical imaging software environment.

privileged_info_for_vlm: For case LIDC-IDRI-0001, a valid MPA diameter measurement should fall between 14.9 mm and 45 mm. The normal range for an MPA is 19.5 mm to 29 mm; any value above 29 mm should be interpreted as 'enlarged' or 'dilated' in the clinical_interpretation field.
